import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;
    static final int SIZE = 1 << 20; // 1048576

    static long power(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = res * base % MOD;
            base = base * base % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long modInv(long x) {
        return power(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static void addMod(int[] arr, int idx, int y) {
        arr[idx] += y;
        if (arr[idx] >= MOD) arr[idx] -= MOD;
    }

    static void subMod(int[] arr, int idx, int y) {
        arr[idx] -= y;
        if (arr[idx] < 0) arr[idx] += MOD;
    }

    static void fwt(int[] a, int opt) {
        int n = SIZE;
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = i; j < i + half; ++j) {
                    if (opt == 1) {
                        addMod(a, j, a[j + half]);
                    } else {
                        subMod(a, j, a[j + half]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        long[][] p = new long[10][10];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = (long) val * modInv(100) % MOD;
            }
        }
        if (n < 6) {
            for (int i = n; i < 6; ++i) p[i][i] = 1;
            n = 6;
        }
        int fullMask = (1 << 6) - 1; // 63
        int[] id = new int[64];
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(i) == 3) id[i] = cnt++;
        }
        int[] X = new int[SIZE];
        int[] Y = new int[SIZE];
        // Process rows 0..2
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); ++i) {
            int m1 = i & fullMask;
            int m2 = (i >> 6) & fullMask;
            int m3 = (i >> 12) & fullMask;
            int mask = 0;
            long prob = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                if ((m1 >> j & 1) == 1) prob = prob * p[0][j] % MOD;
                else prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[0][j]) % MOD;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                if ((m2 >> j & 1) == 1) prob = prob * p[1][j] % MOD;
                else prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[1][j]) % MOD;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                if ((m3 >> j & 1) == 1) prob = prob * p[2][j] % MOD;
                else prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[2][j]) % MOD;
            }
            for (int a = 0; a < 6; ++a) {
                if (((m1 >> a) & 1) == 0) continue;
                for (int b = 0; b < 6; ++b) {
                    if (a == b || ((m2 >> b) & 1) == 0) continue;
                    for (int c = 0; c < 6; ++c) {
                        if (a == c || b == c || ((m3 >> c) & 1) == 0) continue;
                        int triple = (1 << a) | (1 << b) | (1 << c);
                        mask |= 1 << id[triple];
                    }
                }
            }
            addMod(X, mask, (int) prob);
        }
        // Process rows 3..5
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); ++i) {
            int m1 = i & fullMask;
            int m2 = (i >> 6) & fullMask;
            int m3 = (i >> 12) & fullMask;
            int mask = 0;
            long prob = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                if ((m1 >> j & 1) == 1) prob = prob * p[3][j] % MOD;
                else prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[3][j]) % MOD;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                if ((m2 >> j & 1) == 1) prob = prob * p[4][j] % MOD;
                else prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[4][j]) % MOD;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                if ((m3 >> j & 1) == 1) prob = prob * p[5][j] % MOD;
                else prob = prob * (MOD + 1 - p[5][j]) % MOD;
            }
            for (int a = 0; a < 6; ++a) {
                if (((m1 >> a) & 1) == 0) continue;
                for (int b = 0; b < 6; ++b) {
                    if (a == b || ((m2 >> b) & 1) == 0) continue;
                    for (int c = 0; c < 6; ++c) {
                        if (a == c || b == c || ((m3 >> c) & 1) == 0) continue;
                        int triple = (1 << a) | (1 << b) | (1 << c);
                        triple ^= fullMask;
                        mask |= 1 << id[triple];
                    }
                }
            }
            addMod(Y, mask, (int) prob);
        }
        fwt(X, 1);
        fwt(Y, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < SIZE; ++i) {
            X[i] = (int) ((long) X[i] * Y[i] % MOD);
        }
        fwt(X, -1);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < SIZE; ++i) addMod(X, i, 0); // actually we need to add X[i] to ans
        // The above line is wrong; we need to sum X[i] for i>0
        // Correct:
        for (int i = 1; i < SIZE; ++i) {
            ans = (ans + X[i]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
